spec_features.spec_quote: give_up is included on purpose as an explicit, low-friction exit
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:170-172 dispatches the give_up tool (sets gave_up=True), and harness.py:179-180 `if gave_up: break` honors it as a hard stop of the loop. The tool is also offered in SYSTEM_PROMPT (line 44) and the first user prompt.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired: the model can emit {"tool":"give_up"} and the loop terminates that turn.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:127 default max_turns=30; harness.py:148 `for turn in range(max_turns):` bounds the entire episode loop, so the loop cannot exceed max_turns iterations. Passed through from run_experiment.py:42 (--max-turns default 30).
spec_features.notes: Enforced bound on total turns the subject is driven through.

spec_features.feature_name: early end on solve or give-up
spec_features.spec_quote: The loop also ends early on solve... or give-up
spec_features.evidence: Solve: run_tests sets solved=True (harness.py:168-169 when 'tests PASSED' in obs) and harness.py:182-183 `if solved: break`. Give-up: harness.py:179-180 `if gave_up: break`. Both conditions actually break the for-loop.
spec_features.notes: Both early-exit triggers are computed and acted upon. The solve break is a stop-when-solved efficiency; give-up is the model bailing.
